## Cove Compressor v2.6.0

Changes since v2.5.0.

### Fixes

- **Bundled FFmpeg and ffprobe are found reliably in packaged builds.** A
  frozen build now looks inside its own PyInstaller bundle first, then next to
  the executable, then on `PATH`. In a packaged Linux build a candidate that is
  not executable is skipped instead of being picked and failing later.

### Improvements

- **Keyboard-friendly empty queue.** The empty Images and Videos queues now
  show **Add files…** and **Add folder…** buttons with a visible focus ring;
  Enter activates the focused button.
- **New shortcuts:** `Ctrl+O` adds files and `Ctrl+Shift+O` adds a folder to
  the queue on the current tab.
- Keyboard focus is kept sensible when the queue switches between empty and
  populated, and when you switch tabs.

### Release pipeline

- Every release is now assembled by one final job that runs only after the test
  suite (Ubuntu and Windows) and both platform builds have passed. It verifies
  all eight files and their checksums before it creates the release as a draft.
- Each build job now writes and verifies its `.sha256` files before uploading,
  so the binaries and their checksums are downloadable together as workflow
  artifacts.
- Both bundled tools (`ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`) are verified inside the AppImage,
  the `.deb`, the installed Setup and the Portable exe before a release is
  assembled.
- CI installs FFmpeg and ffprobe on both runners and verifies them before the
  full test suite runs on Linux and Windows.
- A release tag must match the version in the source.

### Downloads

| OS      | File                                        |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Windows | `cove-compressor-2.6.0-Setup.exe`           |
| Windows | `cove-compressor-2.6.0-Portable.exe`        |
| Linux   | `Cove-Compressor-2.6.0-x86_64.AppImage`     |
| Linux   | `cove-compressor_2.6.0_amd64.deb`           |

Each file has a matching `.sha256`. Verify with
`sha256sum -c <file>.sha256` (Linux) or `Get-FileHash <file>` (Windows).
`ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` are bundled in every download.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Sin213/cove-compressor/compare/v2.5.0...v2.6.0
